testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.termsofuse.store.TermsOfUsePromptRepositoryTest

testcase.name: WHEN updateLastTermsOfUsePromptTimeInMillis is called THEN the preference is updated
WHEN incrementTermsOfUsePromptDisplayedCount is called THEN the preference is updated
WHEN all upstream conditions are satisfied THEN still do not show the prompt
GIVEN debug mode WHEN user was last prompted less than 30 seconds ago and postponed accepting ToU THEN userPostponedAndWithinCooldownPeriod returns true
WHEN user has already accepted the ToU THEN don't show the prompt
GIVEN debug mode WHEN user was last prompted over 30 seconds ago and postponed accepting ToU THEN userPostponedAndWithinCooldownPeriod returns false
WHEN user was last prompted over 5 days ago and postponed accepting ToU THEN userPostponedAndWithinCooldownPeriod returns false
WHEN the prompt is already showing THEN do not show the prompt
WHEN updateHasPostponedAcceptingTermsOfUsePreference is called THEN the preference is updated
WHEN user has already seen the maximum number of prompts THEN don't show the prompt
WHEN updateHasAcceptedTermsOfUsePreference is called THEN the related ToU preferences are updated
GIVEN debug mode WHEN user was last prompted 30 seconds ago and postponed accepting ToU THEN userPostponedAndWithinCooldownPeriod returns false
WHEN user was last prompted 5 days ago and postponed accepting ToU THEN userPostponedAndWithinCooldownPeriod returns false
WHEN user was last prompted less than 5 days ago and postponed accepting ToU THEN userPostponedAndWithinCooldownPeriod returns true
WHEN the prompt feature is disabled THEN don't show the prompt
